summary: Iteration 54 - Lottery Reorganization Features Testing. All 22 API tests PASSED (100%). Features tested: lottery sorting (open first, closed last), 12-hour display_time format, display_closing 10 min before draw, 7:00 AM opening_time, closed lottery messages, multi-play ticket creation, receipt image PNG generation, multi-prize draw creation, and multi-play partial resolution.

All lotteries have display_closing set to 10 minutes before draw time
Lotteries are correctly sorted: open lotteries first, closed lotteries last
Closed lotteries show message 'Abre mañana [day] a las 7:00 AM'
Multi-play ticket creation works correctly with single and multiple plays
Receipt image endpoint returns valid PNG with company logo, QR code, and ticket details
Multi-prize draw endpoint correctly marks winners and losers
Multi-play tickets with plays in multiple lotteries: only marks plays as won/lost for drawn lotteries
Ticket status stays 'pending' until all plays are resolved, then becomes 'lost' or 'won'
